natural.name: service_tier
natural.description: Ordinal tier of the transport service booked for a consignment (0 = fastest promise, 3 = slowest).

natural.name: promised_transit_days
natural.description: Days quoted to the client for the consignment to arrive.

natural.name: handling_lead_days
natural.description: Days between booking and dispatch (internal handling before carrier pickup).

natural.name: serve_distance_km
natural.description: Great-circle distance from destination to the network hub, in km.

natural.name: line_count
natural.description: Number of distinct product lines in the consignment.

natural.name: unit_total
natural.description: Total units across all lines of the consignment.

natural.name: mean_markdown
natural.description: Average markdown applied to the consignment's lines.

natural.name: same_day_workload
natural.description: Consignments booked by the seller on the same day (workload proxy).

natural.name: zone_weekly_bookings
natural.description: Consignments headed to the same zone in the same week (local demand proxy).

natural.name: arrival_slip_days
natural.description: Actual transit days minus promised transit days; positive = late (outcome).
